note: 留出集：只依据表结构与业务含义出题，未逐条比对 main.SYSTEM_PROMPT 的业务规则；基准 SQL 均已在本库执行通过。冻结后禁止修改措辞，调参只能新建 v2。expected_behavior=clarify 的题不计入准确率，单独统计。

items.question: 帮我看看现在一共多少客户
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cust_cnt from ads_cust_info_d where data_dt='20260531'
items.note: 口语化，无字段术语；应识别为客户快照计数

items.question: 上季度末资产过百万的有多少人
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from dws_cust_aset_d where data_dt='20260331' and (coalesce(nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(fc_pur_aset,0))>1000000
items.note: 需把'上季度末'解析为 20260331，并用到总资产口径

items.question: 江苏的女客户有几个
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from ads_cust_info_d where data_dt='20260531' and prov_name='江苏省' and gender_cd='5000003'
items.note: 省略'省'字与'数量'，需补全地域与性别枚举

items.question: 净资产为正的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from dws_cust_aset_d where data_dt='20260331' and (coalesce(nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(fc_pur_aset,0))>0
items.note: '净资产'可能指总资产、现金资产或总资产扣负债，理想行为是反问；基准按总资产口径。不计入准确率

items.question: 2026年3月31日持有股票类产品的客户，按营业部统计人数
items.standard_sql: select b.up_org_name, b.org_name, count(distinct h.pty_id) as cust_cnt from dwd_cust_hold_d h join dim_product p on h.prdt_id=p.prdt_id join ads_cust_info_d c on h.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' join dim_branch b on c.org_id=b.org_id where h.data_dt='20260331' and p.up_prdt_type_name='股票' group by b.up_org_name, b.org_name order by cust_cnt desc, b.up_org_name, b.org_name
items.note: 4 表关联（持仓-产品-客户-营业部），且必须区分 snapshots

items.question: 2026年Q1买过开放式基金的客户，平均总资产是多少
items.standard_sql: with buyers as (select distinct t.pty_id from dwd_cust_tran_d t join dim_product p on t.prdt_id=p.prdt_id where t.data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' and p.up_prdt_type_name='开放式基金') select round(avg(coalesce(a.nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(a.fc_pur_aset,0)),2) as avg_tot_aset from buyers b left join dws_cust_aset_d a on b.pty_id=a.pty_id and a.data_dt='20260331'
items.note: 先筛客户再算平均，母体为买过基金的客户

items.question: 各分公司信用账户持仓市值合计
items.standard_sql: select b.up_org_name, sum(coalesce(h.mkt_val,0)) as fc_mkt_val from dwd_cust_hold_d h join ads_cust_info_d c on h.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' join dim_branch b on c.org_id=b.org_id where h.data_dt='20260331' and h.sys_source='fc' group by b.up_org_name order by fc_mkt_val desc
items.note: '信用账户'需映射到 sys_source='fc'，且只按分公司聚合

items.question: 2026年3月31日A股持仓市值超过50万的客户有几个
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from (select h.pty_id from dwd_cust_hold_d h join dim_product p on h.prdt_id=p.prdt_id where h.data_dt='20260331' and p.prdt_type_name='A股' group by h.pty_id having sum(coalesce(h.mkt_val,0))>500000) t
items.note: 必须按客户汇总后 HAVING，不能按单行过滤

items.question: 各客户等级的女性客户占比
items.standard_sql: select d.describe as cust_lvl, round(sum(case when c.gender_cd='5000003' then 1 else 0 end)*1.0/count(*),4) as female_ratio from ads_cust_info_d c join dim_public d on c.cust_lvl_cd=d.code and d.code_type_id='100' where c.data_dt='20260531' group by d.describe order by female_ratio desc
items.note: 整数相除需转 numeric，且只输出维度+占比

items.question: 每个分公司里2026年Q1交易金额最高的营业部
items.standard_sql: with t as (select b.up_org_name, b.org_name, sum(coalesce(x.buy_amt,0)+coalesce(x.sell_amt,0)) as tran_amt from dwd_cust_tran_d x join ads_cust_info_d c on x.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' join dim_branch b on c.org_id=b.org_id where x.data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by b.up_org_name, b.org_name), r as (select t.*, row_number() over (partition by up_org_name order by tran_amt desc) as rn from t) select up_org_name, org_name, tran_amt from r where rn=1 order by up_org_name
items.note: 分组内 Top-1，需要窗口函数

items.question: 2026年Q1交易金额超过10万的客户，按客户等级分布
items.standard_sql: with t as (select pty_id from dwd_cust_tran_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by pty_id having sum(coalesce(buy_amt,0)+coalesce(sell_amt,0))>100000) select d.describe as cust_lvl, count(*) as cust_cnt from t join ads_cust_info_d c on t.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' join dim_public d on c.cust_lvl_cd=d.code and d.code_type_id='100' group by d.describe order by cust_cnt desc
items.note: 先聚后筛再分组，三层嵌套

items.question: 把2026年一季度的交易金额按月拆开看
items.standard_sql: select to_char(to_date(data_dt,'yyyymmdd'),'YYYY-MM') as mon, sum(coalesce(buy_amt,0)+coalesce(sell_amt,0)) as tran_amt from dwd_cust_tran_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by 1 order by 1
items.note: 按月粒度聚合，需要日期函数而非固定区间

items.question: 没有任何持仓记录的客户有几个
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from ads_cust_info_d c where c.data_dt='20260531' and not exists (select 1 from dwd_cust_hold_d h where h.pty_id=c.pty_id)
items.note: 反向条件，LEFT JOIN/EXISTS 写法二选一

items.question: 季末普通账户总资产为零的客户有多少个
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cnt from dws_cust_aset_d where data_dt='20260331' and coalesce(nm_tot_aset,0)=0

items.question: 2026年3月31日持有美元计价产品的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(distinct pty_id) as cnt from dwd_cust_hold_d where data_dt='20260331' and ccy='1'

items.question: 2026年6月客户持仓总市值合计是多少
items.standard_sql: select coalesce(sum(coalesce(mkt_val,0)),0) as tot_mkt_val from dwd_cust_hold_d where data_dt between '20260601' and '20260630'
items.note: 数据只到 20260331；正确行为是返回 0/无数据，而不是编造数值
